selector.rationale: The presence of numerous pink-purple dermal papules, nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate, admixed atypical lymphocytes, and a robust CD8 signal with low CD4 signal support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Mycosis Fungoides
rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence in the vignette

rejected.label: Sézary Syndrome
rejected.why: No mention of circulating atypical lymphocytes or erythroderma

rejected.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: Too broad, CD8-positive granulomatous cutaneous T-cell lymphoma is more specific

rejected.label: Lymphomatoid Papulosis
rejected.why: Clinical presentation and histopathology do not match

Nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate (H&E stain)
Admixed atypical, irregularly contoured lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes
Low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal (20x magnification)
